items.claim: Wes Schultz defeated Jackson McVey quickly via a 40-second armbar in their first fight.
items.quote: how their first fight went quick submission for the side of Wes Schultz like 40 second arm bar

items.claim: Jackson McVey has two losses by submission in his professional career.
items.quote: You look at Jackson McVeyy's pro losses two by submission.

items.claim: Wes Schultz is a submission ace who is dangerous on the ground.
items.quote: Wes Schultz a submission ace a guy that doesn't quit on himself

items.claim: Jackson McVey's takedown defense remains seriously questionable.
items.quote: Jackson McVeyy's takedown defense is still seriously in question.

items.claim: Jackson McVey prefers to fight on the inside with dirty boxing and close-range strikes despite being 6'4".
items.quote: the strongest area for Jackson McVeyy's striking from what I've seen is on the inside. At 6'4, I want to see him kickboxing from distance... but he likes to dog it out in dirty boxing
